summary: Share chat via public link: snapshot share page + fork-to-continue
description: Snapshot-based public sharing for chat sessions. Owner shares a chat -> immutable snapshot (messages + rich citations + settings) behind a random slug at /share/[slug], viewable un-authed (modeled on public blog pages). Visitors hit Continue-conversation -> Clerk sign-in/up if needed -> fork endpoint copies the snapshot into a new session they own, with settings persisted (voice/mode/study_text_id copied; owner tradition/text scope snapshotted into sessions.scope_override JSONB, NULL for normal sessions) and accounting zeroed (tokens=0 cost_usd=0 model/tier NULL so backfill-cost.ts recomputes $0; avoids analytics double-count; user_budgets untouched by design). Voice is grandfathered on fork (no tier re-check, consistent with session-voice immutability). Study sessions shareable; missing study_text_id after corpus re-import surfaces as empty retrieval, no fallback. Design hashed out in Claude session 2026-07-11.

resolution.note: All 7 subtasks complete: migration 015 (session_shares + sessions.scope_override/forked_from_share_id), query-route scope_override, share API (POST/DELETE, snapshot w/ rich citations + frozen scope), public /share/[slug] (noindex, revoke-gated, tailnet-safe), share strip in chat, fork endpoint (settings persisted, accounting zeroed), continue-conversation w/ Clerk bounce + auto-fork. 629 tests green; public flow smoke-tested end-to-end on dev server against real DB.
